articles.headline: Samuel Riggs wins Menards 150
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
Samuel Riggs won Menards 150 at Kansas Speedway, starting P2 and leading 65 laps. Karson Mitchell finished second and Nick Apollo was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 4 cautions.

Nick Apollo was the biggest mover, gaining 24 spots from P27 to P3.

King Robinson leads the championship with 3034 points, 148 ahead of Nick Apollo.
articles.author: Jamie Kowalski
